descByPlatform.chatgpt:
Medium Shot Luxury Product Photograph for MERIDIAN 1946 Fountain Pen heritage campaign. Subject: matte-black titanium fountain pen #111111 with 18k gold nib #D4AF37 engraved 'MERIDIAN 1946' 4pt serif on cap band, cap uncapped posted at 12° resting on cognac Full-Grain Saffiano leather portfolio #8B5A2B with visible cross-hatch grain, Noir de Jais glass ink bottle #0B0B12 at 35° tilt camera-right with brass cap, cream linen writing pad top-left with single handwritten loop in wet ink. Composition: Rule of Thirds pen shaft diagonal 28° leading-line, Centered 50% x 54% y, Eye-Level 8° overhead, pen 46% of frame. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 120mm LS Macro at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 50, tripod, focus-stacked 6 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — 4×6ft softbox camera-left 45° elevation 1.5m (key), 1×3ft strip rim camera-right 30° grazing nib at 1.0m (rim), 4×4ft white bounce below 0.6m (leather fill), 4×4ft black flag overhead to deepen background. Material physics: Saffiano cross-hatch specular, titanium micro-brushed grain, 18k gold nib polished facet, glass refraction through ink. Color grade: Capture One Warm-16 LUT grain 7 +0.1 EV. Palette: cognac leather 44%, matte black 26%, gold 16%, ink black 10%, linen cream 4%. References: Irving Penn Vogue still life, Peter Lippmann Hermès, Montblanc archive. Exclude: fingerprints, flat lighting, plastic reflection, cluttered props, colour cast.

Text anchor: render 'MERIDIAN 1946' twice if possible: once engraved on the pen cap band and once clearly printed on the flat ivory card; prioritize the flat card for exact spelling.
